accepted.title: The Fellowship Email
accepted.text: The email arrives: you got selected for the month-long summer science camp in Bengaluru. Yash high-fives you, grinning ear-to-ear, while Ma dials Dadi to celebrate. options.consequence: Yash nods and sits beside you. "That makes sense. It's a huge step, but we'll video call every evening."

options.text: Pretend I only feel pure excitement and start bragging about the campus
options.consequence: Everyone cheers, but late that night you lie awake with the nervous flutter still stuck in your chest.

options.text: Shrug and say the camp probably won't even be that interesting
options.consequence: Yash looks confused by your flat reaction, and the celebration in the kitchen quiets down.

options.text: Slip away to my room and search online for reasons to cancel my spot
options.consequence: You read about the strict schedule, feeling more overwhelmed instead of addressing what you actually feel.
